name: @youtyan/code-viewer
description: Local browser-based code and git diff viewer

scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:server
scripts.build:web: bun build --target=browser --format=iife --outfile=web/app.js web-src/app.ts && bun build --target=browser --format=esm --outfile=web/mermaid.js web-src/mermaid-entry.ts && bun build --target=browser --format=esm --outfile=web/shiki.js web-src/shiki-entry.ts && node scripts/generate-third-party-notices.mjs
scripts.test:docker:up: bun run test:redis:up && bun run test:redis:seed && bun run test:elasticsearch:up && bun run test:elasticsearch:seed && bun run test:postgres:up
scripts.test:docker:down: sh -c 'status=0; bun run test:redis:down || status=$?; bun run test:elasticsearch:down || status=$?; bun run test:postgres:down || status=$?; exit $status'
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run lint && bun run check:format && bun run build && bun run check:bundle && bun run test && node --check web/app.js && node --check web/mermaid.js && node --check web/shiki.js && node --check dist/code-viewer.js && node dist/code-viewer.js --help && node scripts/node-smoke.mjs
